dedupe_keys.name: prometne mreze iz temeljne topografske baze inspire

description: Prometne mreže iz Temeljne topografske baze - INSPIRE is a dataset listed in NIPP Geoportal Croatia, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoportal.dgu.hr. The Transport Network Data Set – INSPIRE contains harmonised data on transport networks in the Republic of Croatia in accordance with the INSPIRE theme ‘Transport networks’. The data was created by the transformation of the original data from the Basic Topographic Database, managed by the State Geodetic Administration. Coverage: HR. The portal shows the English title as "Transport networks from the Basic Topographic Base - INSPIRE" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include inspiregeoportal, topografija, topološki podaci, Prometne mreže, TTB. The listing shows 3 download or service links in WMS, ATOM. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nipp.
